hooks.command: if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then exit 0; fi; { echo '--- auto-logged '"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"' ---'; echo 'Changed files:'; git status --porcelain; echo; echo 'Diff stat:'; git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null; echo; echo 'Recent commits:'; git log --oneline -5; echo; } >> PROGRESS.md.pending
